title: Brand hue personality cues for landing pages
statement:
For brand-led landing pages, hue can be used as a personality cue: red/orange/yellow were associated with excitement, blue/brown with competence, black/purple/pink with sophistication, and green/brown with ruggedness. (DOI)

Options:
- Exciting red: red (fits: energetic, bold, urgent)
- Warm orange: orange (fits: playful, energetic, approachable)
- Competent blue: blue (fits: reliable, professional, technical)
- Sophisticated black: black (fits: premium, formal, exclusive)
- Rugged green: green (fits: natural, robust, grounded)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general, fintech, health, luxury, b2b. Audience: adults, b2b buyers, general.

source.title: Exciting red and competent blue: the importance of color in marketing
source.authors: Lauren I. Labrecque; George R. Milne
source.venue: Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science
